# ProKit Studio Database Notes

This ProKit Studio wrapper uses a simple database model:

- One Postgres connection string via `DATABASE_URL`
- Prisma migrations run directly against that connection
- No multi-tenant schema/user lifecycle in ProKit Studio

## Local vs production

- Local: Docker Postgres is the default path
- Production: recommended walkthrough uses Supabase
- Not required: any Postgres provider is supported
- On Vercel production builds, ProKit Studio runs `prisma migrate deploy` automatically via `db:migrate:vercel-build`

## Commands

```bash
npm run db:init
npm run db:migrate:dev
npm run db:migrate:prod
```

`db:init` only verifies that `DATABASE_URL` is reachable.
